source_endpoints: GET /api/v1/cash-flow/forecast (top_cost_items confirm April actuals via descriptions)
_metadata.method: Drivers identified by filtering recurring_payment table for items with annual_month=4 or quarter_months including 4 — i.e. items that fire in April outside the normal monthly run-rate. Confirmed against cash-flow forecast top_cost_items, whose descriptions reference April 2026 actuals (Skatteverket 206K Apr 2026, Forvis 100K a conto April). Bank_outflow_transaction table empty for April (CSV not yet imported) — could not compute transaction-level rolling deviation, so used recurring-payment metadata as the authoritative source for April-only obligations. A 4th April annual (Schibsted AGM ads 7.6K) omitted as below materiality.
data_caveats: Total April delta vs March: -106K SEK. The three drivers sum to -340.5K, larger than the net delta — this reflects that April also had positive cashflow (revenue collections, ~2.2M implied) and DBT Capital ~134K amortization+interest was DELAYED from April 28 to May 11 due to credit-line saturation (offsetting outflow).
Rainbow to the Stars 38.8K supplier invoice hejdad May 1 due to SEK saldo headroom of only 428 SEK at EOM Apr — confirms cash position tightness, not an April driver per se.

Bank_outflow_transaction table empty for Feb 2026 and Apr 2026 — bank CSV import process appears not yet run for those months. Cash position totals come from auto-populated end-of-month balances (account-level snapshots), not transaction sums.
